chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Abdillah ibn Ja'far narrated to me from his father, from Ahmad ibn Abi 'Abdillah Al-Barqi, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur, who said:

Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever visits the grave of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) for the sake of Allah and in the way of Allah, Allah will free him from the Hellfire and make him safe on the Day of the Great Terror. And whoever does not ask Allah, the Exalted, for any of the needs of this life or the Hereafter, He will grant it.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards of visiting the grave of Imam Al-Husayn (a.s.)?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith underscores the theological significance of *Ziyarat al-Arba'in* and general visitation to Imam Al-Husayn (a.s.) as a means of intercession and divine mercy. It emphasizes that sincere visitation secures liberation from Hellfire and protection during the 'Great Tremor' (*Al-Faza' al-Akbar*), while also guaranteeing the fulfillment of all worldly and spiritual supplications, reflecting the Shia belief in the intercessory power of the Ahl al-Bayt.
